paragraphs: The “Furniture” category is a top-level department in Shopify’s product taxonomy. It brings together the product families assigned to Furniture, providing the starting point for classification throughout this branch of the catalog. Its immediate branches include Baby & Toddler Furniture, Beds & Accessories, Benches, Cabinets & Storage, Carts & Islands and additional specialized categories.

When describing products in Furniture, useful Shopify classification details include Color: Defines the primary color or pattern, such as blue or striped; Pattern: Describes the design or motif of a product, such as floral or striped. These are descriptive comparison points rather than required GitStore category fields; retain the product’s actual characteristics when choosing a category. Where an immediate branch describes the product more precisely, follow that branch and continue to the most appropriate specific category.
